observations: Photo shows a Yamaha keyboard, electronic piano style, with model text 'PSR-175' printed on the body (photo 0).
Display screen shows some lit segments/icons, suggesting the unit may power on, but this cannot be confirmed as a live, functioning display versus a static image or screen artifact.
Full keyboard (61 keys) visible, no obvious cracks, missing keys, or physical damage in the single angle shown.
Only one top-down photo provided; no close-up of ports, power adapter, back panel, or any visible wear/scratches.
No video or audio evidence of sound output, volume control, or functioning buttons.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the keyboard powered or display lit, but no audio/video proof of actual key response, sound output, or full functionality is provided.

claims.claim: It's used but working perfectly well
claims.evidence: No clip or sound sample given; condition claim rests solely on seller's words.

risks.risk: Keys may be unresponsive, sticky, or missing functionality (common wear issue on used keyboards).
risks.proof: A video showing each key being pressed with audible sound and a pan across the full keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not fully functional / for parts or heavy discount

risks.risk: Speakers or audio output may be damaged or silent.
risks.proof: A video clip with volume turned up, playing a demo song or pressing keys to confirm clear sound from both speakers.

risks.risk: Power adapter may be missing or incompatible with Oyo electrical fitting.
risks.proof: Photo of the power adapter and the unit plugged in and powered.
risks.if_unproven: priced as item without adapter, requiring buyer to source one

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage, cracks, or missing keys/buttons on sides or back not shown in the single photo angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos of all sides, back panel, battery compartment, and ports.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible cosmetic/functional defects not visible

risks.risk: Display/LCD could have dead pixels or fading, status may be falsely static in a photo.
risks.proof: A live photo or video with the screen showing a running function (e.g., tempo counter changing).

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on, with keys being played and sound heard from speakers.
Photos of the back panel, power adapter, and all ports (headphone, sustain pedal, USB/MIDI if any).
Close-up photos of both side panels and underside for scratches, cracks, or missing feet.
Confirmation of power adapter inclusion and its voltage/type.
response.reason: The model is identifiable from the photo, but the core seller claim of 'working perfectly' cannot be judged from a single static image; a functionality video and additional angles are needed before even a worst-case price can be fairly set, since 'working vs non-working' drastically changes the price bracket for this item.
